summary: Live emulator exited during isolated regression work
symptom: The live port 8765 listener and its mGBA process disappeared after clone regression commands; exact termination time and owner were not captured.

unexpected.predicted: Disposable clones terminate only their unique-port listener and the protected live mGBA remains idle-stopped on port 8765.
unexpected.actual: No live mGBA process remained. The newest post-first-grunt checkpoint was intact and restored to canonical state d641c92b26fca056.

authority.oracle: The unique PID listening on live port 8765 must remain present and preserve canonical state d641c92b26fca056 across clone startup and teardown.

hypotheses.claim: A clone teardown selected the live listener PID instead of its unique-port listener.
hypotheses.predicted_discriminator: PID/port tracing will show a teardown signal sent to the port-8765 owner.
hypotheses.result: not reproduced by one subsequent clone; unresolved

hypotheses.claim: The original long-running launcher/session exited independently of clone cleanup.
hypotheses.predicted_discriminator: Future clone PID traces preserve port 8765 while the launcher lifecycle records the live exit separately.

solution.workaround: Relaunch from the newest SHA-verified forward checkpoint and verify the exact canonical RAM hash before continuing; capture live and clone listener PIDs around future clone runs.

targeted_checks.name: one post-recovery clone isolation probe
targeted_checks.evidence: clone returned state d641c92b26fca056 and the live port then returned the same hash

action_changing_unknowns: The exact process owner and termination signal for the original live mGBA exit were not captured.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Clone cleanup can incorrectly target the live listener.
next_experiments.action: Before the next necessary disposable clone, record live and clone listener PID/port pairs, run one read-only clone, then record both pairs again.
next_experiments.expected_discriminator: The clone PID disappears while the unchanged live PID remains bound to 8765 and returns the protected canonical hash.
next_experiments.risk: Low; the newest forward checkpoint is SHA-verified and relaunchable.
next_experiments.cost: One clone launch, two lsof reads, and two canonical observations.
next_experiments.rollback: Relaunch only the newest forward checkpoint and require state hash d641c92b26fca056.
